name: 08520 · East Windsor, NJ
findings: ZIP 08520 (East Windsor) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08520 (East Windsor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08520 (East Windsor) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
